title: `resources/read`
description: Reads the contents behind a resource URI, which may return several contents for one request.
question: Can the agent read a resource's contents through the framework?
notes: Both adapters read a resource, but Pydantic AI strips the identity from the contents; 3 cannot reach the revision.

notes_by_num.1: CrewAI 1.15.1 requires MCP Python SDK 1.26.x, so it cannot open a 2026-07-28 adapter session.
notes_by_num.2: LangChain MCP Adapters 0.3.2 requires mcp<2.0.0, so it cannot open a 2026-07-28 adapter session.
notes_by_num.3: Pydantic AI 2.40.0: a text resource is returned as a bare string. The contents arrive intact, but the `uri` and `mimeType` that identify them are dropped, so the agent cannot tell which resource it just read.
notes_by_num.4: Mastra 1.17.3 negotiated MCP 2025-11-25. The scanner refused to compare that capture with a 2026-07-28 source.

verdict.headline: Readable in both, but Pydantic AI returns contents without their identity.
verdict.detail: OpenAI Agents SDK 0.22.0 returns the full `ReadResourceResult`, preserving `uri` and `mimeType` alongside the text. Pydantic AI 2.40.0 returns just the string. Both deliver the content; only one lets the agent say where it came from. CrewAI, LangChain and Mastra cannot negotiate MCP 2026-07-28, so they reach none of it.

usage_note: Not published. Candidate source: count of public MCP servers using this capability. Not estimated, so the panel stays empty until the corpus is scanned.
why: Listing resources without reading them is a catalogue with no way to open anything. This row is where the primitive becomes usable, and it is also where a framework that returns only the first of several contents starts losing data.
